CREATE procedure [bawary_sut].[readeskisutler]
(
@musteri_kodu int
)
as
begin
SELECT     musteri.musteri_kodu, musteri.musteri_adi, musteri.musteri_soyadi, alinan_sut.sut_fiyat, alinan_sut.sut_lt, alinan_sut.sut_tutar, 
                      alinan_sut.tarih AS süt_tarihi
FROM         alinan_sut INNER JOIN
                      musteri ON alinan_sut.musteri_kodu = musteri.musteri_kodu
WHERE     alinan_sut.musteri_kodu = @musteri_kodu
order by alinan_sut.tarih desc;
end
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[detayaurun]
(
@musteri_kodu int,
@tarih1 datetime,
@tarih2 datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SELECT     musteri.musteri_kodu as KODU, musteri.musteri_adi AS ADI, musteri.musteri_soyadi AS SOYADI, alinan_urun.urun_fiyat AS FIYAT, alinan_urun.urun_adet AS ADET, 
                      alinan_urun.urun_tutar AS TUTAR, urun_kodu.urun_adi AS CINSI, alinan_urun.tarih AS VER_TARIH
FROM         musteri INNER JOIN
                      alinan_urun ON musteri.musteri_kodu = alinan_urun.musteri_kodu INNER JOIN
                      urun_kodu ON alinan_urun.urun_kodu = urun_kodu.urun_kodu




where (alinan_urun.tarih >= @tarih1) AND (alinan_urun.tarih <= @tarih2) AND (musteri.musteri_kodu = @musteri_kodu)
end
GO

@musteri_kodu int,
@urun_kodu int,
@urun_fiyat float,
@urun_adet float,
@urun_tutar float,
@tarih datetime
)

as 
begin


select urun_id, musteri_kodu, urun_kodu, urun_fiyat, urun_adet, urun_tutar, tarih from verilen_urun 
where musteri_kodu=@musteri_kodu 

order by verilen_urun.urun_id  desc ;

end
begin

UPDATE verilen_urun
	SET 

urun_kodu =@urun_kodu ,
urun_fiyat =@urun_fiyat, 
urun_adet =@urun_adet ,
urun_tutar =@urun_tutar,
tarih =@tarih
where urun_id=@urun_id 



end

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[editvpara]
(
@para_id int,
@musteri_kodu int,
@verilen_para float,
@alinan_para float,
@tarih datetime
)

as 
begin

where musteri_kodu=@musteri_kodu 

order by para.para_id  desc ;

end
begin

UPDATE para
	SET 
verilen_para =@verilen_para,
alinan_para =@alinan_para,
tarih =@tarih
where para_id=@para_id 



end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetAlbums]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetAlbums]
	@IsPublic bit
AS
	SELECT 
		[Albums].[AlbumID], 
		[Albums].[Caption], 
		[Albums].[IsPublic], 
		Count([Photos].[PhotoID]) AS NumberOfPhotos 
	FROM [Albums] LEFT JOIN [Photos] 
		ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] 
	WHERE
		([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	GROUP BY 
		[Albums].[AlbumID], 
		[Albums].[Caption], 
		[Albums].[IsPublic]
RETURN

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetFirstPhoto]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetFirstPhoto]
	@AlbumID int,
	@Size int,
	@IsPublic bit
AS
	IF @Size = 1
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesThumb] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [Albums].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 2
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesPoster] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [Albums].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 3
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesFull] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [Albums].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 4
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesOriginal] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [Albums].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesPoster] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [Albums].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
RETURN

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetNonEmptyAlbums]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetNonEmptyAlbums]
AS
	SELECT 
		[Albums].[AlbumID]
	FROM [Albums] LEFT JOIN [Photos] 
		ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] 
	WHERE
		[Albums].[IsPublic] = 1
	GROUP BY 
		[Albums].[AlbumID], 
		[Albums].[Caption], 
		[Albums].[IsPublic]
	HAVING
		Count([Photos].[PhotoID]) > 0
RETURN

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPhoto]
	@PhotoID int,
	@Size int,
	@IsPublic bit
AS
	IF @Size = 1
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesThumb] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [PhotoID] = @PhotoID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 2
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesPoster] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [PhotoID] = @PhotoID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 3
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesFull] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [PhotoID] = @PhotoID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE IF @Size = 4
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesOriginal] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [PhotoID] = @PhotoID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
	ELSE
		SELECT TOP 1 [BytesPoster] FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums] ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] WHERE [PhotoID] = @PhotoID AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
RETURN

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetPhotos]
	@AlbumID int,
	@IsPublic bit
AS
	SELECT *
	FROM [Photos] LEFT JOIN [Albums]
		ON [Albums].[AlbumID] = [Photos].[AlbumID] 
	WHERE [Photos].[AlbumID] = @AlbumID
		AND ([Albums].[IsPublic] = @IsPublic OR [Albums].[IsPublic] = 1)
RETURN

CREATE procedure [dbo].[readsut_verpara]
@musteri_kodu int

AS	
BEGIN
SELECT 
alinan_sut.musteri_kodu,
alinan_sut.sut_tutar,
alinan_sut.sut_fiyat,
alinan_sut.sut_lt,
alinan_sut.tarih,

para.tarih
	
	FROM alinan_sut INNER JOIN para
		ON alinan_sut.musteri_kodu = para.musteri_kodu

	WHERE
		(alinan_sut.musteri_kodu = @musteri_kodu and para.musteri_kodu=@musteri_kodu and para.verilen_para>0)
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[readtsaynigun]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure  [dbo].[readtsaynigun]
(

@tarih datetime
)
AS	
BEGIN
SELECT  musteri_kodu, sut_lt,  COUNT(sut_lt) AS adet 
FROM alinan_sut WHERE 
(alinan_sut.tarih =@tarih)
GROUP BY sut_lt, musteri_kodu
HAVING (COUNT(sut_lt) > 1)
end
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[readtsfarkligun]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[readtsfarkligun]
(

@tarih datetime,
@tarih2 datetime
)
AS	
BEGIN
SELECT  musteri_kodu, sut_lt,  COUNT(sut_lt) AS adet 
FROM alinan_sut WHERE 
(alinan_sut.tarih >= @tarih) and (alinan_sut.tarih<=@tarih2) 
GROUP BY sut_lt, musteri_kodu
HAVING (COUNT(sut_lt) > 1)
end

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[readyem_alpara]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create procedure [dbo].[readyem_alpara]
@musteri_kodu int

AS	
BEGIN
SELECT 
verilen_urun.musteri_kodu,
urun_kodu.urun_adi,
verilen_urun.urun_fiyat,
verilen_urun.urun_adet,
verilen_urun.urun_tutar,
verilen_urun.tarih,
para.alinan_para,
para.tarih
	
	FROM verilen_urun INNER JOIN para
		ON verilen_urun.musteri_kodu = para.musteri_kodu
INNER JOIN urun_kodu
on verilen_urun.urun_kodu=urun_kodu.urun_kodu

	WHERE
		(verilen_urun.musteri_kodu = @musteri_kodu and para.musteri_kodu=@musteri_kodu and para.alinan_para>0)
END


GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[stokurunsayisi]    Script Date: 5/4/2019 9:43:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE procedure [dbo].[stokurunsayisi]
(
@urun_kodu int,
@urun_adet float,
@sumaua float,
@sumvua float,
@stok float output
)
as
begin
set @stok=(@sumaua - @sumvua)
end
begin
select sum (alinan_urun.urun_adet) as sumaua from alinan_urun inner join
verilen_urun on verilen_urun.urun_kodu=alinan_urun.urun_kodu
where alinan_urun.urun_kodu=@urun_kodu
end
begin
select sum (verilen_urun.urun_adet) as sumvua from verilen_urun inner join
alinan_urun on verilen_urun.urun_kodu=alinan_urun.urun_kodu
where verilen_urun.urun_kodu=@urun_kodu
end



	
	
		



GO
